request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, soft cello, light percussion, reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In your righteousness deliver me
Rescue me and save
Turn your ear to me and hear
Be my rock of refuge
You gave the command to save
You are my fortress

[Chorus]
For you are my hope Lord GOD
My confidence from my youth
On you I have leaned since birth
You brought me from my mother's womb

[Verse]
My praise is always of you
A wonder to many
But you are my strong refuge
My mouth is filled with your praise
Your splendor all day long

[Chorus]
For you are my hope Lord GOD
My confidence from my youth
On you I have leaned since birth
You brought me from my mother's womb

[Bridge]
Do not cast me off in old age
Do not forsake me when strength fails
I have leaned on you since birth
You are my strength and my salvation

[Chorus]
For you are my hope Lord GOD
My confidence from my youth
On you I have leaned since birth
You brought me from my mother's womb

[Outro]
My confidence from my youth
My hope forever
